$description: GENERATED by design-system/build-manifest.mjs from component source. Do not edit. Read the guide of a component before using it.

components.name: Alert
components.description: Inline message about the state of the page or a task. Not for blocking questions (use Dialog).

props.name: children
props.description: Message text in Finnish: what happened and what to do next.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the dismiss button.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the user dismisses the alert. When set, a close button is shown.

props.name: title
props.description: Short bold summary in Finnish, e.g. "Tallennus epäonnistui".

props.name: tone
props.description: Meaning of the message. `warning` and `danger` interrupt screen readers (role="alert"); `info` and `success` are announced politely (role="status").

notes: The role is set from the tone. The message is text plus an icon, so it never relies on color alone.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Short status label, e.g. invoice state ("Maksettu", "Erääntynyt") or customer state ("Aktiivinen").

props.name: children
props.description: Status text in Finnish, e.g. "Maksettu".

props.name: tone
props.description: Meaning of the status. Pick by meaning, not by color.

notes: Always contains text. Tone only reinforces the meaning.

components.name: Button
components.description: Triggers an action. Use `primary` for the main action, `secondary` for alternatives, `ghost` for low-emphasis actions and `danger` for destructive ones.

props.name: children
props.description: Visible label.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button while an action runs. Sets `aria-busy`.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis. Use one `primary` per view area; `danger` for destructive actions; `link` for an inline action that looks like text, e.g. a customer name that opens its details. `link` ignores `size`.

notes: The label must describe the action. For icon-only buttons use IconButton.

parts.name: IconButton
parts.description: Square button with only an icon. Prefer Button with a visible label when space allows.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name in Finnish, e.g. "Poista asiakas".

props.name: icon
props.description: Decorative icon, e.g. from the design system icon set. It is hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button while an action runs. Sets `aria-busy`.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis. Use one `primary` per view area; `danger` for destructive actions.

notes: The `aria-label` prop is required and must be Finnish and action-oriented.

components.name: Card
components.description: Bordered surface that groups related content. Compose with CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent and CardFooter.

notes: A Card is a plain container. Give it a CardTitle so the group has a heading.

parts.name: CardFooter
parts.description: Bottom section of a Card for actions, right-aligned.

parts.name: CardHeader
parts.description: Top section of a Card. Usually holds a CardTitle and optionally a Badge or Button on the right.

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level. Choose the level that continues the page outline without skipping levels.

components.name: DescriptionList
components.description: Read-only list of labelled values (term and definition), e.g. the basic details of a customer. Compose with DescriptionItem.

props.name: children
props.description: DescriptionItem elements.

notes: Rendered as a native `dl`, so screen readers announce each term with its value.

parts.name: DescriptionItem
parts.description: One term and its value inside a DescriptionList. Stacked on narrow screens, side by side from `sm`.

props.name: children
props.description: The value. Plain text, or a Badge for a status.

props.name: term
props.description: Label in Finnish, e.g. "Y-tunnus".

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Modal window for a focused task or a confirmation. Compose with DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogFooter and DialogClose.

props.name: children
props.description: DialogTrigger (optional) and DialogContent.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog requests to open or close (Esc, overlay click, close button).

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

notes: Focus moves into the dialog, is trapped there, returns to the trigger on close; Esc closes.

parts.name: DialogClose
parts.description: Wraps an element that closes the dialog when activated.

props.name: children
props.description: A single interactive element, usually a secondary Button ("Peruuta"). It closes the dialog.

parts.name: DialogContent
parts.description: The dialog window with overlay, title, description and a close button.

props.name: children
props.description: Body content, and a DialogFooter with the actions.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button.

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences explaining the purpose or consequence.

props.name: size
props.description: Width of the dialog.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog title in Finnish. Names the dialog for screen readers.

parts.name: DialogFooter
parts.description: Right-aligned action row at the bottom of the dialog.

props.name: children
props.description: Action buttons. Put the primary action last.

parts.name: DialogTrigger
parts.description: Wraps the element that opens the dialog.

props.name: children
props.description: A single interactive element, usually a Button. It receives the open behavior.

components.name: Input
components.description: Single-line text field with built-in label, hint and error message.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Setting it marks the control invalid and links the message to it.

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper text shown under the label and linked with `aria-describedby`.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, in Finnish. Always shown above the control.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required and shows an asterisk. Explain the asterisk once per form.

props.name: type
props.description: Input type.

notes: Label is required. Error text is linked via aria-describedby and the control gets aria-invalid.

components.name: Page
components.description: Page container: the `main` landmark with responsive padding, a centered maximum width and a gap between sections.

props.name: children
props.description: A PageHeader followed by the page's sections.

notes: Renders the page's single `main` landmark. Use exactly one per page.

components.name: PageHeader
components.description: Top of a page: the `h1` title and optional page-level actions.

props.name: children
props.description: Page-level actions on the right, usually one primary Button. They wrap below the title on narrow screens.

props.name: title
props.description: Page title in Finnish. Rendered as the page's only `h1`.

notes: Renders the only `h1` of the page. Do not use more than one PageHeader per page.

components.name: Select
components.description: Dropdown for choosing one option, with built-in label, hint and error message.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Marks the control invalid and links the message to it.

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper text linked with `aria-describedby`.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, in Finnish.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; a hidden native select is rendered so the value is submitted with the form.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the chosen option value.

props.name: options
props.description: Choices. Keep the list short; for long lists add search first.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown when nothing is selected.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required and shows an asterisk.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value.

notes: Keyboard: Enter/Space/arrows open the list, arrows move, type-ahead jumps, Esc closes.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Animated placeholder shown while content loads. Mirrors the layout of the content that will replace it.

props.name: label
props.description: Finnish loading message, e.g. "Ladataan asiakkaita...". Announced politely to screen readers.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shape of the placeholder: one line of text or a taller block (input, button, card).

props.name: width
props.description: Width relative to the container.

notes: Placeholders are decorative. Give one Skeleton per loading area a `label` so the loading state is announced.

components.name: Stack
components.description: Lays out its children in a row or column with a token-based gap. The only way for views to arrange things side by side or one above the other; it can switch from column to row at a breakpoint.

props.name: align
props.description: Cross-axis alignment of the children.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to lay out.

props.name: direction
props.description: Main axis. A `column` stack can become a row at `switchAt`.

props.name: fill
props.description: Children share the row width equally (e.g. filter fields side by side). Has no effect while the stack is a column.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between children, from the spacing tokens (1 = 0.25rem, 4 = 1rem).

props.name: switchAt
props.description: Breakpoint (token: sm 640, md 768, lg 1024, xl 1280) at which a `column` stack becomes a `row`. Mobile-first: below it the children are stacked. Ignored for `direction="row"`.

notes: Layout only: it adds no semantics. Source order is visual order, so keep the DOM order meaningful.

components.name: Table
components.description: Data table. Compose with TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell and TableEmpty. Scrolls horizontally on narrow screens; the scroll wrapper is a keyboard focusable `region` labelled "<caption>, vieritettävä".

props.name: caption
props.description: Short title that describes the table, in Finnish, e.g. "Asiakkaat".

props.name: captionHidden
props.description: Hide the caption visually (it stays available to screen readers). Use when a heading above already shows it.

props.name: children
props.description: TableHeader and TableBody.

notes: Caption is required. Use TableHead (scope="col") for column headings and TableCell rowHeader for row headings.

parts.name: TableBody
parts.description: Body group (`tbody`). Contains TableRow elements, or a TableEmpty row when there is no data.

parts.name: TableCell
parts.description: Data cell (`td`), or row heading when `rowHeader` is set.

props.name: numeric
props.description: Right-align with tabular figures; use for amounts, dates and counts.

props.name: rowHeader
props.description: Render as a row heading (`th scope="row"`), e.g. the customer name column.

parts.name: TableEmpty
parts.description: Row shown inside TableBody when there is no data.

props.name: children
props.description: Finnish message, e.g. "Ei asiakkaita." Say what to do next when possible.

props.name: colSpan
props.description: Number of columns in the table, so the message spans the full width.

props.name: numeric
props.description: Right-align the column; use for amounts and counts.

props.name: onSort
props.description: Called when the user activates the column heading. Makes the heading a button.

props.name: sortDirection
props.description: Current sort state of this column. Omit for columns that cannot be sorted.

parts.name: TableHeader
parts.description: Header group (`thead`). Contains one TableRow of TableHead cells.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Switches between related panels of content on the same page. Compose with TabsList, TabsTrigger and TabsContent.

props.name: children
props.description: TabsList and one TabsContent per tab.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially active tab when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the `value` of the newly active tab.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled active tab (the `value` of a TabsTrigger).

notes: Keyboard: arrow keys move between tabs, Home/End jump to first/last, Tab moves into the panel.

parts.name: TabsContent
parts.description: Panel shown when its tab is active.

props.name: value
props.description: Matches the `value` of its TabsTrigger.

props.name: children
props.description: TabsTrigger elements.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the tab group in Finnish, e.g. "Asiakkaan tiedot".

props.name: children
props.description: Short Finnish tab title.

props.name: value
props.description: Identifies the tab; must match the `value` of its TabsContent.
